name: to_your_eternity_orb
about: To Your Eternity story Short: in the beginning it was an orb, cast upon the Earth to observe it; it becomes a rock, then the wolf Joaan, then walks beside a boy left alone in the snow. His last words - remember me - and it takes his form. The drop runs Fushi's journey; ends on it becoming human.

story.why: in the beginning, it was an orb
I decided to cast the orb upon the Earth and observe it
it took on the form of the wolf, and gained consciousness
the boy: I want you to do something for me. Remember me.

outro.why: it took on the form of a human

title: An Immortal Orb Takes The Form Of Everyone It Loses - To Your Eternity
hook: It began as an orb cast upon the Earth. A rock, a wolf, then a boy who died alone in the snow - and it carries every form with it.
